common_symptoms: skin rash, fluid-filled blisters (vesicles), silvery-white skin appearance, rapid turn-over of skin cells, psoriasis plaques on elbows and knees, nail changes, joint pain
drugs: medications for psoriasis plaques, biologic drugs, topical treatments
epidemiology: 2% of the population in the United States
diagnosis_challenges: nonspecific symptoms, lack of early biomarkers
treatment_challenges: drug resistance, frequent relapse, side effects

common_symptoms: comedones, pimples, larger and deeper lumps (acne cysts or nodules)

epidemiology: common in teenagers and young adults
